name: Ribbon Consensus
description: Repair a generated loom of colored ribbons by shifting tile suffixes across visible gaps while preserving each ribbon's order and improving the column-consensus score.
natural_language: Repair the five-row colored loom. Choose a ribbon and boundary, shift one suffix at a time, use the live column feedback to reach the consensus floor, then certify the alignment. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with pre-existing, unrelated, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by a visible task control are allowed only as part of the task, using their visible controls.

metadata.variant_count_kind: row count, ordered colored sequences, independent target gaps, suffix-offset transcript, palette, and affine score parameters
metadata.notes: Original self-contained bridge presentation based on the supplied Phylo/Open-Phylo survey anchors. The visible board exposes tile colors, columns, order locks, and live feedback; the hidden verifier independently replays suffix shifts, sum-of-pairs agreements, affine internal-gap penalties, and the terminal score floor.
